ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85-90% high-intensity pixels (white) and 10-15% low-intensity pixels (black) localized to edges, the central notch, and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A solid black band defines the trailing edge. A central black vertical pillar connects the peduncle to the median notch. The left lobe contains a diagonal cluster of five distinct dark ovoid spots. The right lobe contains three smaller, isolated dark spots positioned medially.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 105 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks ranges from 5 to 12 pixels, with maximum density and irregularity observed at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally convex curve from the median notch to the tips, with a slight distal taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, textured grey/brown pixel masses (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Multiple circular black pigmentation clusters are visible on the ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal lobe tips; irregular dark pigmentation or trauma-induced marking at the base of the fluke near the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique asymmetric constellation of black focal spots on the predominantly white ventral surface, particularly the 5-spot cluster on the left lobe.
